name: tensortransit
status: 0.2.0 -- RecurLocal generalized into TensorTransit: an engine-independent cross-kernel multi-tensor locality planner. Five planners, five admission rules, three reuse metrics, a trace/plan/evaluation schema set, golden plan digests, and a CLI that plans and compares offline. Every 0.1 name still resolves and the shim is tested rather than assumed. MEASURED: the migration did not change what the recurrent policy does -- +0.13% at a 0.06% floor on Qwen3.8-27B batch 1, token-exact, which is the figure 0.1 published for that arm (results/rtx5090-0.2-migration-check.json). THE 0.1 ANSWER STANDS, and now applies to one planner rather than to the project: the persist family's ceiling is 2*min(persisting_capacity, footprint)/step_traffic with the numerator pinned at 60 MiB by hardware, reaching 1.94% against a 2.0% significance floor on the best model found, and that model is not scorable because the runtime is not reproducible on it. NEW AND NEGATIVE: under the linear cost model no admission rule can beat greedy-on-density, so the global planner beats the naive both-persistent arm 10x and cannot beat the best single-role arm. The three terms a linear model cannot express -- whole-line residency, survival past the reuse distance, and interference between the streaming and persisting halves of the cache -- are named in docs/evaluation.md, and a cost model carrying them is the highest-value open contribution. It needs no GPU. The Transit Graph reproduces every published 0.1 bound from a recorded trace rather than a hand-written geometry file (293.6 MiB removable, 146.8 MiB footprint, 40.9% resident, +1.69% traffic ceiling, +0.685% persist ceiling), and tests/test_golden.cpp asserts it.
core: software-directed CUDA locality for mutable recurrent LLM state, embeddable in an inference runtime, with enumerated optimization surfaces measured against a real model rather than a microbenchmark
validated: Zero-warning CUDA build on sm_120, ctest 3/3, 102 Python checks, 319 planner checks (including a fabricated device-capability matrix that needs no GPU: A100-like, H100-like, a part whose persisting L2 is smaller than one layer's state, one with more persisting L2 than the whole footprint, one reporting zero, and one whose two capacity numbers contradict), 120 device-side controller checks, compute-sanitizer clean, install + find_package, a documented API/ABI stability contract with static_asserts a consumer's own build runs, and a standalone probe that reads an access-policy window back off a graph captured with the attribute set mid-capture, at 1 to 128 nodes
